title: Virtual Compute: dedicated tenancy multiplier
content:
## Meaning — dedicated tenancy multiplier

Virtual Compute dedicated tenancy multiplier: Dedicated tenancy multiplier on primary compute usage; decimal.

## Tier values — dedicated tenancy multiplier

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — dedicated tenancy multiplier: 1.16.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — dedicated tenancy multiplier: 1.16.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — dedicated tenancy multiplier: 1.16.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — dedicated tenancy multiplier: 1.16.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — dedicated tenancy multiplier: 1.16.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — dedicated tenancy multiplier: 1.16.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for dedicated tenancy multiplier?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has dedicated tenancy multiplier of 1.16.
